pages.title: Potion Shelf
pages.text: The potion shelf has twelve slots shared by both faces. Right-click a compartment with a potion to store it. Sneak-right-click the compartment to eject its potion. Click without a potion to open the menu.
Use the same wood for the plank and slab pieces.

pages.title: Tool Rack
pages.text: Right-click the front with a tool to hang it in one of four slots. Right-click the same slot with an empty hand to take the tool down. Sneak-right-click to open the menu.
Both drills cycle a rack’s depth. Sneak-use rotates the opening and the displayed items.
